name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A surface that rises from the bottom of its container for one short job and then goes: reward detail, the options of a select on touch, share, filters, more. A scrim over the scene, a panel anchored to the foot of the container with a grab handle, a header row of art, kicker, title and a line of body, whatever the host puts in the middle, then a primary action and a ghost under it. It is modal while open: focus is held inside the panel, Escape closes it, a tap on the scrim closes it, and focus goes back to what had it. Capped at sixty percent of its container, because anything taller is a page. Unmounted rather than hidden when closed; whether the player dismissed it is the host's state. Performs nothing: what the actions do is the host's, and it holds no state of its own beyond where focus was.
docs: Put `position: relative` on the surface the sheet belongs to and render the sheet inside it; it covers that surface and anchors to its foot. Pass `open` and `onDismiss` as a controlled pair: the host owns whether it is open, and `onDismiss` is called on the scrim, on Escape and on the ghost action. `label` is the dialog's accessible name and is required. Give it `title`, `kicker`, `media` and `description` for a header row, `primaryAction` and `secondaryAction` for the two controls under the content, or none of them and put a list of options in `children`. The primary action does not close the sheet; what it does is the host's, and the host closes the sheet when it is done. Open one at a time: each holds focus.
